title: Comedy
style: Country male vocals upbeat fun guitar fiddle
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Your modesty’s a myth, they say
A unicorn that ran away
Each pose, a gift to humankind
How thoughtful of your perfect behind

[Verse 2]
You walk like every step’s an applause
Physics bends to serve your cause
Oh, humble queen of mirror glass
Forever reign, dear Sweet, Sweet Ass

[Chorus]
Oh, Miss Sweet Ass, you steal the show
Wherever you walk, the hearts all go.
You know the power that you wield
A smile, a glance, and the crowd’s all sealed

[Verse 3]
The sun gets jealous when you pass
Because it can’t outshine that southern sass
You tilt your hips, time stops, it seems
And half the world forgets their dreams

[Chorus]
Oh, Miss Sweet Ass, you steal the show
Wherever you walk, the hearts all go.
You know the power that you wield
A smile, a glance, and the crowd’s all sealed

[Bridge]
So here’s to you
that perfect view
The kind that makes the sky more blue
If confidence were cash and class
You’d own the bank, Miss Sweet Sweet Ass.

[Chorus]
Oh, Miss Sweet Ass, you steal the show
Wherever you walk, the hearts all go.
You know the power that you wield
A smile, a glance, and the crowd’s all sealed

[End]
Oh, Miss Sweet Ass, how grand you are
The sweetest ass I’ve see by far
